scope: Replace the existing live territory-war cannon firing effect at the user's request

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game VFX animation sprite atlas, one muzzle-blast effect, transparent RGBA. Create ONE 2048x2048 square sprite sheet with EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 equal square cells, no gaps or borders. Read frames left to right, top to bottom. Every cell contains one successive moment of the SAME giant siege-cannon muzzle flash, firing horizontally toward the RIGHT. Fixed emitter pivot at 22% cell width and 52% cell height in every frame, fixed camera and scale. Frame 1 tiny hot ignition and compressed wisps; 2-4 white-hot yellow core bursts into a sharply directional cone; 5-7 detailed ragged orange flame lobes and pressure-driven vapor expand along the rightward axis; 8-10 the flame tears into several curling tongues and individually visible glowing embers; 11-14 turbulent gray-brown muzzle smoke rolls and separates, flame extinguishing; 15-16 fine drifting wisps and a few fading embers. Change the actual physical forms between frames, continuous believable evolving fluid motion, NOT one static flash scaled or faded. Realistic hand-painted AAA dark fantasy artillery VFX matching a stormy fortress siege, cinematic textured volumetric flame, soot and sparks; disciplined bloom, clear detail, crisp organic silhouette. Effect fits wholly within each cell with at least 7% padding on every edge. No weapon, no background, no ground, no characters, no text, no numbers, no labels, no checkerboard, no circular outline, no geometric ring, no neon laser line. Fully transparent background, semitransparent smoke and soft edge alpha. The whole image is ONLY this one 16-frame sequence.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent RGBA game VFX animation sprite atlas for a siege-cannon projectile. Create ONE 2048x1024 wide sprite sheet in EXACTLY 4 columns and 2 rows, eight equal 512x512 cells, no gaps, borders, numbers or labels. In every cell the same rightward-flying hot artillery shell / dense white-gold plasma slug is positioned at 72% cell width and 50% cell height, pointing exactly horizontally RIGHT. Maintain consistent projectile size and position; luminous tapering orange-gold turbulent exhaust extends behind it to the LEFT, with brief gray smoke wisps and tiny scattered cinders. These are eight successive animated turbulent flight frames, continuous loop; exhaust shape, broken flame filaments and smoke eddies physically change every frame, not copies with scaling. Projectile tip recognizable, heavy hot metal, compact concentrated white-yellow head, richly textured orange flame tail that tapers rather than a rectangular trail. High-end painterly semireal dark fortress artillery VFX; realistic matter, restrained bloom. No beam, no straight neon line, no magic circle, no UI, no objects outside cell boundaries; 9% safe cell margins. Fully transparent background, no black rectangle and no checkerboard. One eight-frame animation asset only.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game VFX animation atlas for heavy siege artillery hitting stone fortifications. Create ONE 2048x2048 square PNG sprite sheet with EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows of 16 equal square frames, no gutters or borders. Read left to right then top to bottom. All frames share the exact same fixed camera and impact position at 50% cell width, 71% cell height, same scale. The SINGLE explosion visibly evolves physically across 16 successive frames. Frames 1-2 tight white-yellow detonation contact; 3-5 expanding jagged orange fireball with detailed churning flame lobes and a powerful fan of shattered dark stone fragments; 6-8 large uneven fiery blast crown, curling dark smoke, outward ejected splinters and glowing cinders; 9-12 thick billowing charcoal and ochre dust, fire receding into small broken pockets, stones falling in ballistic paths; 13-16 settling irregular low dust clouds, dwindling embers, smoke thinning toward full dissipation. High-end painterly semireal dark fantasy war VFX, textured volumetric fire, soot, heavy masonry debris. NOT a generic yellow glow, NOT identical sprites scaled up, NOT a ring: each phase is a newly drawn continuous evolving shape. Use irregular ground-hugging dust sheet instead of a geometric circular outline. Keep the entire effect within each cell including debris with a minimum 6% transparent margin and constant grounding point. No scene, no fortress, no character, no gun, no text, no frame labels, no checkerboard or opaque background. Genuine transparent alpha with translucent smoke and soft light edges. One coherent 16-frame explosion sequence only.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent game sprite, a single heavy fortress siege gun emplacement, NOT a scene. Reference image 1 is design/material reference ONLY: keep its massive straight black-gunmetal reinforced cannon, lime-white core bands and dark Gothic stone foundation language. Create a side three-quarter camera view that will be placed in the lower-left of a wide battlefield. Barrel points diagonally upper RIGHT at exactly 18 degrees above horizontal, with its visible muzzle near (86% width, 25% height). Entire pedestal/base sits near (43% width, 85% height). One cannon with ONE continuous absolutely straight rigid barrel from breech to muzzle; all structural segments, longitudinal rails and luminous core channels have the same axis and consistent perspective. No bent barrel, no drooping muzzle, no separate misaligned front part. Compact readable wide silhouette, restrained detail, heavy armored recoil cradle and a squat reinforced dark stone plinth. Match the reference's sophisticated painterly semi-real dark fantasy game rendering, cool slate shadows, dim green-white band lighting, crisp metallic edges; no exaggerated bloom. Lighting from upper left. No firing effect, no smoke, no projectile; this is the stationary weapon sprite only. No background, no landscape, no floor plane outside the small attached base, no cast shadow rectangle, no text, no UI, no border, no logos, no checkerboard. Real transparent alpha. Whole gun and whole base visible with 8% empty transparent safety margin around all sides. Wide composition about 3:2. The image has one gun only.
